entities.summary: Barbara Anna Schaal American scientist, evolutionary biologist, is a professor at Washington University in St. Louis and served as vice president of the National Academy of Sciences from 2005 to 2013. She is the first woman to be elected vice president of the academy. Barbara A. Schaal was a naturalists & biologists from Berlin (b. 1947, Berlin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
